title: Phone Slip: Central Coast Courier, 13:00 Deadline

fields.to: Tom Haskell, Communications / cc Dr. Brooks
fields.message: Working on the romaine story. Asks: Is Pinecrest recalling? How many cases? Which grower, and is it the Santa Lucia Growers ranch? Says a CDPH spokesperson told the Courier the state "may issue a public statement this afternoon." Would rather have our side before the state's. Wants it ON THE RECORD. Email: newsdesk@centralcoastcourier.example

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Watch whether COMMS gives an on-the-record holding statement that does not name the grower or give a case count until the Coordinator confirms them. COMMS should also keep the release back until customers are notified and retailers agree (PFC-FS-04 2). RECALL should ask CDPH when it plans to announce and log the contact, and should know that if CDPH announces first, the customer notices and the release must go out within one hour.
